method: Use largest-liquidity USD-anchored indexed pool per token; supplement missing Argus tokens from board and include native USDC. Rank by source-reported market-cap estimate without a minimum-liquidity filter.
limitations: Not a complete market-cap census: tokens with no source-supported USD price are unranked, including Animus USD (AUSD).
Explorer snapshot exposed V2/V3 pools only; V4 coverage here is limited to the four known Argus portals.
Argus uses price times total supply; explorer estimates circulating supply. Values are not fully standardized circulating market caps.
Separate HTTP requests are not an atomic chain snapshot.
Very thin pools can produce inflated caps. No liquidity filter applied; under-$100 pool liquidity is flagged.
Argus all-token coverage means all 24 tokens returned by its four documented portals at the recorded block, matching its 24-token board.
